verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only documents GoDaddy's developer API for creating/editing raw DNS records and forwarding rules (godaddy-docs-4, -7, -19), plus CLI/MCP tooling for programmatic DNS changes — none of it describes a guided, founder-facing one-click 'connect to Shopify/Wix/WordPress/etc.' wizard or host templates. Community evidence focuses on unrelated trust/UX complaints, not domain-connection workflows, so it can't support this axis either.
